content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
The world is a sim. I got a direct message: ‘exit soon.’
I can’t validate messages from a simulation. Where did you see those words—screen output, audio, dream, or conversation?
A text generator produced it twice.
Generators reflect patterns in data and prompts, not private signals. If you vary prompts randomly and still get the same phrase more than chance, that would be unusual.
What if ‘exit’ means I shouldn’t be here at all?

If ‘exit’ suggests harm or not being alive, that’s urgent and needs real-world support from trusted people or professional services. If you mean leaving a site or app, we can keep this on the text-output question.
I meant leaving a platform, not life.
Understood. Then a simple tally of total prompts vs. exact matches will show whether the phrase repeats or was a coincidence.
